ge.wd1: English comedy special with Tera Kilbride and La Revue genevoise on Thursday to round off the week.
ge.we1: Final weekend of Festival du Soir (Kalkbrenner, Megalloween), GIFF opens, plus Plainpalais flea market and an English philosophy café; dry but cool.
ge.wd2: GIFF runs all week, with English pub philosophy on Wednesday, a free community choir and a crochet vernissage on Thursday.
ge.we2: Les Automnales opens at Palexpo, GIFF's final weekend, the last monthly brocante of the year and a Paint & Prosecco evening on Friday.

zh.wd1: Expovina wine fair opens on the lake ships and Basel's Herbstmesse is in full swing.
zh.we1: Last Bürkliplatz flea market of the season, the Rosenhof crafts market, Halloween parties and Crafty Sunday; dry but cold.
zh.wd2: Placebo at Hallenstadion on Wednesday, English stand-up mid-week, an evening art class on Tuesday and Expovina still on.
zh.we2: Urban sketching and a realistic drawing workshop on Saturday, a resin class, and the final weekend of Basel's Herbstmesse.

picks.why: Free English-language philosophy chat in Rousseau's old-town birthplace; easy to join on your own.
Group sketching outing among the trees and famous graves of the Cimetière des Rois.
Geneva's big open-air flea market: vintage finds, records and bric-a-brac; dog-friendly stroll.
Last weekend of Festival du Soir at Palexpo: Kalkbrenner on Friday, giant Megalloween on Saturday.
Geneva's film, series and digital-art festival runs all week, with screenings, VR and parties.
Free live philosophy discussion in English in a pub near Cornavin; friendly regulars.
Free community choir, no experience needed: songs from all over the world.
Opening night for a show of inventive crochet pieces at La Nativa in Plainpalais.
Last Bürkliplatz flea market of the season, right by the lake; bring the dog.
Handmade crafts, jewellery and ceramics at the little Rosenhof market in the Niederdorf.
Free, relaxed pumpkin-carving afternoon at Norden Bar; a fun way to meet people.
Make something with others at House of Craft; free, but get a ticket first.
Free weekly language exchange at Lady Hamilton's pub; lots of newcomers each week.
Drawing, painting, printmaking and sculpting in one weekly evening class in Wiedikon.
Placebo's 30th anniversary tour at Hallenstadion; three decades of alt-rock hits.
Zurich's weekly English stand-up open mic for CHF 5; half the room comes alone.

a-ge-language-exchange-geneva-10-28.desc: Free language exchange at Halle de l'Ile: tables by language, a relaxed crowd and an easy way to meet new people.

a-zh-speed-friending-day-rave-10-24.desc: Speed friending at a daytime rave in Enge: quick rounds of chat over coffee and croissants, then dance. Free, but get a ticket via social-circle.ch.

a-ge-drink-paint-and-meet-spooky-hallowe.desc: A Halloween-themed paint-and-drink evening at Lucha Libre: paint a spooky canvas, have a drink and meet new people. All materials included.

a-zh-portrait-sketches-workshop-10-24.desc: Portrait sketching workshop with artist Proximus Mustafa, focused on presence and self-expression; beginners welcome.

a-zh-figu-rliches-zeichnen-von-antiken-s.desc: Figure-drawing session among ancient sculptures in the University of Zurich's archaeology collection, practising proportion, movement and perspective.

a-ge-122-atelier-croquez-monsieur-madame.desc: Life-drawing afternoon with two models at Quai du Seujet, with poses from short sketches to long studies; all levels welcome.

a-ge-atelier-pictura-espace-du-quartier-.desc: Evening life-drawing session with a model at the Saint-Jean community space, 18:30–20:30; bring your own materials.

a-ge-sketchcrawl-cimetiere-des-rois-10-3.desc: A group sketching outing at the Cimetière des Rois in Plainpalais. Bring a sketchbook and draw alongside others.

a-zh-zu-rich-mosaiklampen-herstellungs-w.desc: Make your own Turkish mosaic lamp in a hands-on workshop in Kreis 3; all materials provided and you take the lamp home.

a-ge-paint-flirt-ceramic-edition-by-soci.desc: Ceramic-painting social evening for ages 22–35 at Ceramic KANVAS. Free, but get a ticket via social-circle.ch.

a-ge-32e-mondial-de-l-impro-finale-10-24.desc: The final of the World Amateur Improv Championship at the BFM, after nine days of heats between French-speaking teams (in French).

a-ge-les-puces-de-nyon-quartier-de-rive-.desc: Nyon's monthly flea market on the lakeside Rue de Rive, with antiques, vintage and bric-a-brac; a lovely day trip with the dog.

a-zh-tropical-watercolors-11-01.desc: Paint watercolours from life inside the warm tropical greenhouses of the University of Zurich's Botanical Garden.

a-ge-atelier-broderie-x-renc-art-10-26.desc: Free embroidery workshop with Cosmina D. at Pavillon bleu in Les Grottes, exploring embroidery as a way of telling stories.

a-ge-marche-aux-puces-brocante-de-plainp.desc: Geneva's big flea market on the Plaine de Plainpalais, with vintage clothes, records, furniture and bric-a-brac. Free to browse.

a-ge-pub-philosophy-in-english-11-04.desc: An hour and a half of live philosophical discussion in English in the downstairs room of the Crowned Eagle Pub near Cornavin. Free and open to all.

a-ge-community-choir-free-11-05.desc: A free community choir at Holy Trinity Church: no experience needed, just enthusiasm. Songs from every continent and genre.

a-ge-vernissage-gito-ts-le-crochet-autre.desc: Opening of an exhibition of handmade crochet pieces by Jorge Trujillo (GITO TS) at La Nativa. A relaxed evening for craft lovers.

a-zh-crafty-sunday-11-01.desc: A social crafting afternoon at House of Craft in Kreis 4: make something, chat and meet people. Free, but a ticket from social-circle.ch is needed.

a-zh-multidisciplinary-art-workshop-draw.desc: A weekly evening art class covering drawing, painting, printmaking and sculpting at artworkshops.club in Wiedikon. All levels.

a-zh-speaking-together-your-weekly-langu.desc: A free weekly language exchange at Lady Hamilton's Pub: practise languages and meet people in a friendly international crowd.

a-ge-bourse-aux-vinyles-brunch-11-01.desc: A record fair with brunch at La Turbine in Jonction. Dig through crates of second-hand vinyl over a late breakfast.

a-ge-atelier-papier-de-coupe-10-31.desc: A paper-cutting workshop with Simone Découpe at the Palais de l'Athénée, from drawing to cutting out your design. CHF 10.

a-ge-atelier-dessin-gratuit-pour-adultes.desc: A free character-drawing workshop for adults on Place Duchêne, part of Onex's 175th anniversary celebrations.

a-ge-brocante-mensuelle-au-coeur-de-gene.desc: The last monthly flea market of the year at Espace Terra 17 in Eaux-Vives, with carefully chosen second-hand items. Free entry.

a-ge-fe-te-des-cha-taignes-11-07.desc: Nyon's traditional chestnut festival: roast chestnuts, live music and a small restaurant in the Salle communale. CHF 5.

a-ge-pop-up-store-2026-11-07.desc: About twenty local designers and makers sell their work at Galerie Trajets' pop-up shop, open from 5 November to 3 December.

a-ge-paint-prosecco-live-music-11-06.desc: Paint a canvas with a glass of prosecco and live music at 995 Concept in Eaux-Vives. A ticket from social-circle.ch is needed.

a-ge-les-journe-es-de-verre-10-31.desc: The Musée Ariana's glass weekend: talks, demonstrations, tours and workshops exploring glass art. Free.

a-zh-urban-sketching-location-to-be-anno.desc: Zurich urban sketchers meet to draw or paint a different spot in town each month. All levels; bring your own materials.

a-zh-drawing-workshop-realistisch-zeichn.desc: A beginners' workshop in realistic drawing: learn shading, proportion and how to draw with confidence.

a-zh-zeichnen-skizzieren-illustrieren-11.desc: An evening class in drawing, sketching and illustration at KreativWerkstatt in Kreis 4. Register in advance.

a-zh-paint-the-cat-11-06.desc: A beginner-friendly painting evening: paint a bright pop-art cat with step-by-step guidance.

a-zh-resin-workshop-11-07.desc: A two-hour introduction to resin art covering the key techniques; you take home your own piece.

a-zh-texured-art-10-30.desc: A creative course in textured art at KreativWerkstatt: build up tactile paintings with paste and mixed media.

a-zh-halloween-pumpkin-carving-afternoon.desc: A free, relaxed Halloween afternoon carving and decorating pumpkins together at Norden Bar in Kreis 4.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.when: 16 Oct – 1 Nov · Fri & Sat nights from 19:00
add.title: Festival du Soir — 10th edition at Palexpo
add.desc: Geneva's big indoor night festival takes over Palexpo for three weekends: each Friday and Saturday has its own world, from electronic music and circus to Latin parties, disco revival and a giant Halloween. Open the festival for the night-by-night programme.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: Positiv — Paul Kalkbrenner, Mind Against
add.desc: Festival du Soir techno night with Paul Kalkbrenner, Mind Against, Nicolas Cuer and La Forêt.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: Megalloween — 20th anniversary + Día de los Muertos
add.desc: Festival du Soir's giant Halloween party in costume, with a Día de los Muertos festival running alongside.

add.title: GIFF — Geneva International Film Festival (32nd edition)
add.place: Théâtre Pitoëff and venues around town, Rue de Carouge 52, Geneva
add.desc: Ten days of films, series and immersive/VR experiences, with talks and big GIFF Night parties; many screenings are in English or subtitled.

add.title: Les Automnales — Geneva's autumn fair
add.desc: Geneva's big ten-day autumn fair: a food festival with bars and food trucks, the Arvinis wine fair, a shopping market and an upcycling area; open late on Fri and Sat.

add.title: Expovina — wine ships on Lake Zurich
add.desc: A Zurich classic: ships moored at Bürkliplatz become a floating wine fair with thousands of wines to taste; a fun after-work outing with friends.

add.title: Basler Herbstmesse — 555th Basel autumn fair
add.place: Barfüsserplatz, Münsterplatz, Petersplatz and more, Basel
add.desc: Switzerland's oldest and biggest funfair spreads over seven squares in Basel, with rides, mulled wine, roasted chestnuts and a crafts village and market at Petersplatz.

add.title: Bürkliplatz flea market — last market of the season
add.desc: Final Saturday of the season at Zurich's big lakeside flea market: vintage, antiques, books and curiosities.

add.title: Rosenhof crafts market in the Niederdorf
add.desc: Small Saturday market of local makers and artisans (jewellery, ceramics, textiles) on a pretty square in the Old Town.

add.title: Placebo — 30th Anniversary Tour
add.desc: The British alt-rock band brings its 30th anniversary tour to Hallenstadion, playing hits from three decades.

add.title: Räbechilbi Richterswil — turnip lantern parade
add.desc: Thousands of carved turnip lanterns light up Richterswil's old village in Europe's biggest turnip lantern parade, with a market and music from 15:00. A festival badge (CHF 10, cash) is required; no dogs or strollers.

add.title: Blickfang Zürich — design fair
add.desc: Independent design fair at the Kongresshaus: furniture, jewellery, fashion and homeware sold directly by the designers who make them.
